title: Efficient cascade conversion of glucose to levulinic acid using a dual-functional UiO-66 catalyst
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, 9,596-605
DOI: 10.1039/D4SE01352B, Paper
Sininat Boonmark, Panyapat Ponchai, Kanyaporn Adpakpang, Taya Saothayanun, Yollada Inchongkol, Natchaya Phongsuk, Sareeya Bureekaew
Acid-treated UiO-66, imparting both Lewis and Brønsted acidity, efficiently converts naturally abundant glucose into levulinic acid.
